newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Optus in Australia pay TV restructure talks.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Optus in Australia pay TV restructure talks.

text.p: Optus Communications Pty Ltd on Wednesday it was involved in talks with other pay television operators on how to restructure the loss-making industry.
"We are talking to other Pay TV players on how the industry should be restructured," Optus chief executive Peter Howell-Davies told reporters.
Howell-Davies said that pay TV does not provide the customer with what they want and it does not provide the operator with an adequate return on its investment.
He also said he was concerned about the high "churn rate" from disatisfied customers who cancel contracts in the short-term.

The company expected a decision in the next two months by the Foreign Investment Review Board on Cable & Wireless' planned purchase of Bell South's stake in Optus, which would double the British operators holding to 49 percent.
